places.name: Museum of the Future
places.description: Torus-shaped icon wrapped in Arabic calligraphy with immersive future exhibits.
places.tip: Book timed tickets online; go at opening to skip queues.

places.name: Dubai Frame
places.description: 48-storey picture frame with a glass-floor skybridge linking old and new Dubai.
places.tip: Visit near sunset for views of both skylines.
places.transit: Dubai Healthcare City / Creek Metro + taxi

places.name: Al Shindagha Museum
places.description: Waterfront heritage district telling Dubai's pre-oil story.
places.tip: Combine with Al Seef and an abra ride.

places.name: Etihad Museum
places.description: Museum on the founding of the UAE at the Union House site.
places.tip: Allow 90 minutes; the film is worth it.

places.name: Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood
places.description: Restored wind-tower lanes full of galleries and courtyards.
places.tip: Go early or evening; shaded lanes but hot midday.

places.name: Coffee Museum
places.description: Small Al Fahidi house museum on the history of Arabic coffee.
places.tip: Ask for a tasting of Arabic coffee with dates.

places.name: Heritage House
places.description: One of Dubai's oldest preserved family houses, in Al Ras.
places.tip: Opens in the morning; short visit, pair with Gold Souk.

places.name: Sheikh Saeed Al Maktoum House
places.description: Former residence of Dubai's ruler with rare historic photographs.
places.tip: Free-flowing 45-minute visit near Shindagha.

places.name: Al Fahidi Fort (Dubai Museum)
places.description: Oldest existing building in Dubai, with historical dioramas.
places.tip: Check current opening status before visiting.

places.name: Jameel Arts Centre
places.description: Contemporary art centre on the Creek with a lovely terrace.
places.tip: Free general entry on most days; great sunset terrace.

places.name: Alserkal Avenue
places.description: Al Quoz warehouse art district with galleries, cafes and concept stores.
places.tip: Visit Tuesday to Saturday afternoons for most openings.

places.name: Jumeirah Mosque
places.description: One of few mosques open to non-Muslim visitors on guided tours.
places.tip: Dress modestly; tours run on set mornings.

places.name: Dubai Opera
places.description: Dhow-shaped performing arts venue beside Burj Khalifa.
places.tip: Check the programme; dine on the Boulevard before shows.

places.name: Hatta Heritage Village
places.description: Reconstructed mountain village with forts, watchtowers and crafts.
places.tip: Take the E16 bus from Al Ghubaiba; cooler in winter.

places.name: Saruq Al Hadid Archaeology Museum
places.description: Artefacts from a 4000-year-old desert site near Shindagha.
places.tip: Quiet museum, excellent for a short cool visit.

places.name: Al Seef Heritage Waterfront
places.description: Creek-side promenade mixing old-style architecture and cafes.
places.tip: Best after sunset when lights come on.

places.name: Majlis Gallery
places.description: Courtyard gallery in a traditional wind-tower house in Al Fahidi.
places.tip: Pair with XVA Cafe next door.

places.name: Burj Khalifa At The Top
places.description: Observation decks at the world's tallest building.
places.tip: Book sunset slots weeks ahead; arrive 30 min early.

places.name: The View at The Palm
places.description: Observation deck atop Palm Tower with views over the Palm and Marina.
places.tip: Go at golden hour; use the Palm Monorail.

places.name: Sky Views Observatory
places.description: Observation deck and glass slide at the Address Sky View.
places.tip: Choose a clear afternoon for full visibility.

places.name: Ain Dubai
places.description: Giant observation wheel on Bluewaters Island.
places.tip: Check operating status before planning.

places.name: Dubai Creek Harbour Vista
places.description: Waterfront promenade with Burj Khalifa skyline across the water.
places.tip: Go golden hour; breezy and quiet.

places.name: The Dubai Fountain
places.description: Choreographed fountain show on Burj Khalifa Lake.
places.tip: Shows every 30 min in evenings; stand at the boardwalk.

places.name: Burj Al Arab Viewpoint (Umm Suqeim)
places.description: Classic public beach viewpoint of the sail-shaped hotel.
places.tip: Sunset gives the best photos; parking is limited.
places.transit: Mall of the Emirates Metro + taxi

places.name: Palm Jumeirah Boardwalk
places.description: Elevated promenade on the Palm's trunk with skyline views.
places.tip: Take the monorail out and walk back toward the Gateway.

places.name: JBR The Beach
places.description: Lively beachfront with skyline of Marina and Ain Dubai.
places.tip: Weekday mornings are calmest.

places.name: Dubai Water Canal Bridge
places.description: Glowing bridge and canal promenade near Safa Park.
places.tip: Visit in the evening when the lights are on.

places.name: Madinat Jumeirah (Souk Madinat)
places.description: Waterways, souk lanes and framed views of Burj Al Arab.
places.tip: Take the abra ride at dusk.
places.transit: Mall of the Emirates Metro + taxi

places.name: Gold Souk
places.description: Dense market lanes of gold jewellery in Deira.
places.tip: Bargain politely; compare per-gram rates.

places.name: Dubai Creek Dhow Cruise
places.description: Traditional wooden boat cruise along the Creek.
places.tip: Pick the evening cruise for lit-up towers.

places.name: Abra Ride (Bur Dubai to Deira)
places.description: Cheap and classic wooden-boat hop across the Creek.
places.tip: Pay a few dirhams; board at Bur Dubai Abra Station.

places.name: Dubai Creek Park Cable Car
places.description: Cable car over a shaded park with Creek views.
places.tip: Go late afternoon for cooler air and soft light.

places.name: Hatta Dam
places.description: Turquoise dam lake framed by Hajar mountains.
places.tip: Visit in winter and bring sun protection.

places.name: Dubai Harbour Waterfront
places.description: New promenade with yachts and Palm Jumeirah views.
places.tip: Sunset gives the best skyline glow.

places.name: Spice Souk
places.description: Fragrant Deira market of spices, incense and dried fruit.
places.tip: Start from the abra station and walk up.

places.name: Al Ustad Special Kabab
places.description: Iconic Persian kebab joint serving since 1978.
places.tip: Order chelo kabab and mint yogurt; cash is handy.
places.transit: Al Fahidi / Bur Dubai Metro + taxi

places.name: Arabian Tea House
places.description: Al Fahidi courtyard cafe for Emirati breakfast and tea.
places.tip: Sit outside in cooler months; try balaleet.

places.name: CÉ LA VI Dubai
places.description: Rooftop restaurant and club with sweeping skyline views.
places.tip: Book ahead; smart-casual dress code.

places.name: Pierchic
places.description: Over-the-water seafood restaurant with Burj Al Arab views.
places.tip: Request an outdoor sunset table.
places.transit: Mall of the Emirates Metro + taxi

places.name: Bu Qtair
places.description: Legendary no-frills fish shack near Burj Al Arab.
places.tip: Cash friendly; go before 7pm to beat queues.
places.transit: Mall of the Emirates Metro + taxi

places.name: Time Out Market Dubai
places.description: Food hall with chef-led counters and Burj Khalifa views.
places.tip: Grab a terrace table before the fountain show.

places.name: 3Fils
places.description: Cult casual fusion spot at Jumeirah Fishing Harbour.
places.tip: Book ahead; try the chef's selections.

places.name: Orfali Bros Bistro
places.description: Syrian-brother-led modern Levantine bistro in Wasl 51.
places.tip: Reserve; share dishes to try more.

places.name: Ravi Restaurant
places.description: Long-running budget Pakistani favourite in Satwa.
places.tip: Try the chicken karahi and fresh naan.

places.name: Al Mallah
places.description: Satwa classic for shawarma, falafel and fresh juices.
places.tip: Eat outside at the street tables.

places.name: Al Fanar Restaurant
places.description: Heritage-themed Emirati dining with traditional dishes.
places.tip: Try the machboos and luqaimat dessert.

places.name: Pai Thai
places.description: Romantic Thai dining arriving by abra at Madinat Jumeirah.
places.tip: Book an outdoor table for Burj Al Arab views.
places.transit: Mall of the Emirates Metro + taxi

places.name: Special Ostadi
places.description: Beloved Persian kebab spot in Deira.
places.tip: Come hungry; portions are generous.

places.name: Hatam Restaurant
places.description: Well-known Persian grill in Deira.
places.tip: Pair with fresh herbs and saffron rice.

places.name: Khan Murjan
places.description: Underground-style Moroccan-inspired souk with dining.
places.tip: Great for evenings; bring cash for shopping.

places.name: Sikka Cafe
places.description: Cafe in an Al Fahidi courtyard with Emirati fusion bites.
places.tip: Pair with a walk through the neighbourhood.

places.name: Bayt Al Wakeel
places.description: Creekside traditional restaurant in Bur Dubai.
places.tip: Request a creek-view table; cooler evenings best.

places.name: Nightjar Coffee Roasters
places.description: Specialty coffee roaster with laid-back Al Quoz vibes.
places.tip: Great post-Alserkal Avenue stop.

places.name: Tom&Serg
places.description: Industrial-chic brunch spot in Al Quoz.
places.tip: Weekend brunch gets busy; arrive early.

places.name: Zuma Dubai
places.description: Contemporary Japanese izakaya in DIFC.
places.tip: Book for dinner; reserve the bar for drinks.

places.name: SUSHISAMBA
places.description: Palm-top Japanese-Peruvian bar with skyline views.
places.tip: Go at golden hour; book terrace seats.

places.name: Galaxy Bar
places.description: Stylish lounge for cocktails and live DJs.
places.tip: Check dress code and entry policy first.

places.name: Buddha-Bar Dubai
places.description: Asian fusion lounge with signature Buddha-Bar music.
places.tip: Reserve a table; dress smart.

places.name: Level 43 Sky Lounge
places.description: Sky lounge with Burj Khalifa views.
places.tip: Arrive before sunset for window tables.

places.name: Skyview Bar (Burj Al Arab)
places.description: Luxury lounge with panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf.
places.tip: Reserve in advance; minimum spend applies.
places.transit: Mall of the Emirates Metro + taxi

places.name: At.mosphere
places.description: Fine dining and drinks on level 122 of Burj Khalifa.
places.tip: Reserve ahead; strict dress code.

places.name: Cafe Rider
places.description: Cyclist and biker hangout with coffee and light bites.
places.tip: Perfect before or after a beach ride.

places.name: Pier 7 Dubai Marina
places.description: Seven-level dining and bar tower at Dubai Marina.
places.tip: Ask for terrace levels for views.

places.name: Barasti Beach Bar
places.description: Casual beach bar popular for sundowners.
places.tip: Weeknights are mellow; weekends busy.

places.name: Wild & The Moon DIFC
places.description: Healthy cafe and juice bar in DIFC.
places.tip: Good light-lunch stop near Zuma.

places.name: Jetty Lounge
places.description: Sundowner lounge at One&Only Royal Mirage.
places.tip: Arrive 30 min before sunset.

places.name: XVA Cafe
places.description: Peaceful courtyard cafe and gallery in Al Fahidi.
places.tip: Great afternoon break while exploring Bur Dubai.

places.name: Bateel Cafe (Dubai Mall)
places.description: Cafe famous for premium dates and coffee.
places.tip: Great gifts; try the date pudding.

places.name: Al Qudra Cycling Track
places.description: 86km loop through desert with lakes and flamingos.
places.tip: Go at sunrise in winter; carry water.

places.name: Nad Al Sheba Cycle Track
places.description: Floodlit cycle track popular with club riders.
places.tip: Best for evening rides in cooler months.

places.name: Jumeirah Beach Running Track
places.description: Paved coastal track running past Jumeirah beaches.
places.tip: Run before 8am or after 5pm.

places.name: Dubai Marina Walk
places.description: Flat waterfront promenade around Dubai Marina.
places.tip: Great for 5km loops; sunset is stunning.

places.name: Kite Beach Track
places.description: Beach track with outdoor gyms and watersports.
places.tip: Check wind for kitesurf days.

places.name: Mushrif Park MTB
places.description: Forested park with beginner mountain-bike trails.
places.tip: Weekdays quieter; bring your own bike.

places.name: Zabeel Park
places.description: Large city park with jogging track and lakes.
places.tip: Perfect for easy morning laps.

places.name: Safa Park
places.description: Central park with jogging loops and lawns.
places.tip: Visit early or late to avoid heat.

places.name: Dubai Water Canal Walk
places.description: Promenade along the canal with a lit bridge.
places.tip: Stroll in the evening for cooler air.

places.name: Skydive Dubai Marina
places.description: Tandem skydiving over Marina and Palm.
places.tip: Book ahead; check weather conditions.

places.name: JLT Park
places.description: Pleasant park around Jumeirah Lakes Towers.
places.tip: Good for casual evening runs.

places.name: Dubai Creek Harbour Cycle Path
places.description: Waterfront cycle path with skyline backdrop.
places.tip: Rent a bike near the promenade.

places.name: Hatta Mountain Bike Trails
places.description: Mountain-bike trails around the Hajar mountains.
places.tip: Go in winter; carry plenty of water.

places.name: Hatta Kayaking
places.description: Calm lake kayaking at Hatta Dam.
places.tip: Choose morning slots; wear sun protection.

places.name: Love Lakes (Al Qudra)
places.description: Heart-shaped lakes near Al Qudra with wildlife.
places.tip: Sunrise offers soft light and birdlife.

places.name: La Mer Beach Walk
places.description: Coastal promenade with cafes and a water play area.
places.tip: Visit at golden hour; busy at weekends.

places.name: Bluewaters Promenade
places.description: Walkable island promenade with marina views.
places.tip: Stroll toward Ain Dubai for photos.

places.name: Ski Dubai
places.description: Indoor ski slope with real snow and penguin encounters.
places.tip: Book timed sessions; wear socks and gloves.

places.name: The Green Planet
places.description: Indoor tropical rainforest with animals and plants.
places.tip: Weekday mornings are calm; allow 2 hours.

places.name: Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo
places.description: Giant aquarium tank inside Dubai Mall.
places.tip: Book combo tickets; visit weekdays.

places.name: IMG Worlds of Adventure
places.description: World's largest indoor theme park.
places.tip: Visit on weekdays; wear comfy shoes.

places.name: Deep Dive Dubai
places.description: World's deepest pool for diving experiences.
places.tip: Book a try-dive; no experience needed.

places.name: Museum of Illusions
places.description: Mind-bending optical-illusion museum.
places.tip: Bring a camera; ideal for rainy or hot days.

places.name: Mall of the Emirates
places.description: Giant mall with Ski Dubai and cinemas.
places.tip: Visit at midday to escape the heat.

places.name: Dubai Ice Rink
places.description: Olympic-size rink in Dubai Mall.
places.tip: Skate rentals available; check sessions.

places.name: VR Park Dubai Mall
places.description: Virtual reality attractions inside Dubai Mall.
places.tip: Book online; sessions vary.

places.name: Ibn Battuta Mall
places.description: Mall themed on Ibn Battuta's journeys.
places.tip: Walk the themed courts; great architecture.

places.name: Mercato Mall
places.description: Venetian-style mall on Jumeirah Road.
places.tip: Weekday afternoons are calm.

places.name: Dubai Festival City Mall
places.description: Mall near the Creek with IKEA and dining.
places.tip: Evening laser show is outside.

places.name: City Walk
places.description: Open-air district with dining and art.
places.tip: Better in cooler months; many shaded areas.

places.name: Mirdif City Centre
places.description: Large family mall in Mirdif with cinema.
places.tip: Easy weekday visit; parking ample.

places.name: Wafi Mall
places.description: Egyptian-themed luxury mall in Oud Metha.
places.tip: Visit the pyramid glass roof; great architecture.

places.name: BurJuman Mall
places.description: Central luxury mall with direct metro access.
places.tip: Weekday afternoons are best.

places.name: KidZania Dubai
places.description: Kid-sized city where children role-play jobs.
places.tip: Book morning sessions; allow 4 hours.
